collection: Soulmonsters — água animada, rio e cachoeira

assets.name: Lago claro
assets.brief: Warm turquoise shallow lake water, broad clean calm teal color masses, sparse delicate pale aqua ripple curves, restrained hand-painted caustic shapes, no visible stones or sand.

assets.name: Lago profundo
assets.brief: Deep muted petrol-blue lake water, dark blue broad calm surfaces, sparse thin soft blue-white ripple curves, very restrained reflections, no objects.

assets.name: Rio claro
assets.brief: Fresh turquoise river water seen from directly above, broad teal masses and restrained long light aqua flowing ribbons aligned along the vertical image axis, clean illustrated currents.

assets.name: Rio escuro
assets.brief: Deep blue-green river surface with smooth broad dark teal color masses and sparse pale teal long current ribbons aligned vertically, low contrast and clear game-scale read.

assets.name: Corredeira
assets.brief: Lively turquoise rapids water seen directly above, flowing aqua ribbons and broken white foam streaks aligned vertically, clear broad cel-shaded shapes, no rocks or banks.

assets.name: Água de brejo
assets.brief: Quiet muted olive-teal swamp water, gentle dark green water masses, sparse soft pale green ripple rings, no algae islands, no plants or debris.

assets.name: Cachoeira suave
assets.brief: A flat rectangular repeatable material of falling water viewed straight-on: clean turquoise vertical flowing ribbons, broad pale cyan translucent-looking bands and a few narrow white downward streaks. NO bottom splash or ledge. Seamless vertically and horizontally.

assets.name: Cachoeira forte
assets.brief: A flat rectangular repeatable material of strong falling water viewed straight-on: bright white and pale cyan vertical falling sheets separated by muted turquoise thin streaks, energetic yet clean 2D ribbons, NO rocks, ledge or bottom pool. Seamless vertically and horizontally.

assets.name: Respingo de impacto
assets.brief: ONE isolated low broad oval splash crown for the FOOT of a waterfall in isometric 2:1 view: white and pale aqua foam lobes connected in a wide ellipse with a few tiny attached spray fingers, open transparent centre. No water pool rectangle, no waterfall column, no rocks.

assets.name: Espuma da borda
assets.brief: ONE isolated long narrow gently wavy foam ribbon for the LIP of a waterfall, horizontal across canvas, clean white and pale aqua connected rounded foam lobes, slight 2:1 isometric depth, complete ends, no water background or falling curtain.

assets.name: Anel de ondulação
assets.brief: ONE isolated thin gently broken water ripple RING viewed isometrically, wide flat ellipse 2:1, pale aqua and white fine clean arcs with transparent interior, no shadows, no droplets or water background.

assets.name: Redemoinho
assets.brief: ONE isolated stylized aqua-white spiral foam eddy, wide flat 2:1 isometric ellipse with three gently curling connected tapered ripple arms, transparent gaps and centre, no water background, no rocks, no glow.
